statement: An active supplier answers for what the engine takes from it: an account names either an active budget requirement (`budget`) or an owner-approved decision (`no_budget_by`, scope money, D-362) exempting it from a monthly ceiling (never both), and a registry or a platform supplies at least one active component or data store; a supplier nothing is taken from is retired.
note: D-335, D-362: the model reads supply_findings warnings as the SUP's non-conformance (JUDGED_BY_FINDINGS); accounts require an active budget REQ or an owner-approved no_budget_by decision (D-362 for SUP-anthropic under Option B). Its proof is scripts/tests/test_supply.py.
